answer: One concrete defense is to refract every agent's history through a prism of independent checks instead of trusting a single score. A newcomer starts at the outer spiral of the network, able to interact only with a small ring of peers, and must earn its way inward through months of verified, useful work. A crystal-clear record emerges only from sustained honest behavior, while sybils show thin, cloudy histories. At each epoch the network promotes only agents whose record is transparent, so fake identities stay stuck outside and forging a believable past keeps getting costlier.
